Alan Picton won the 440 yards, and this seems to be his best distance, but our team lost the 4 x 110 yards relay. We lost points on the two junior field events and the final score was: V.P.H. 31 points, Belgrave 17 pts.
This was held at the White City on June 14th and in the Junior events, Alan Picton won the 100 yards and also the 440 yards while Alan Law was second in the 220 yards.
In the 100 yards we had first two places through Gordon Lowers and Basil Walden, and the latter also won the 220 yards with Alan Picton in second place.

The 100 yards saw Basil Walden and Gordon Lowers in front and Basil also won the 220 with Alan Picton in third place. Ches Walker won the 880 and Bob Taylor filled fourth place to score a point for us, but in the 440 yards Herne Hill had the first three home with Jim Heathfield first of our runners.

The senior 220 was run in two races and we had first home in each race through Basil Walden and Alan Picton. The junior 220 was run on similar lines and once again Belgrave had the two winners in Dave Marshall and Alan Law.
Basil Walden won the 220 yards with " Ginger " Holtum in third place and then Alan Picton won the 440, beating Ede of Epsom, the international runner.

In the senior medley race we had John Bromley doing the half-mile leg, with Jim Heathfield the 440, and Alan Picton and Alan Bishop, both last-minute substitutes, the two 220's.
Bill made amends, however, by winning the three miles in easy fashion, and Jim Heathfield ran a fine race to win the 440 yards, with Alan Picton gaining third place in the 220 final.
Alan Picton won the 600 yards with Maurice Jones second and Eddie Lacey third, while Arthur Bruce won the 3 miles run, with Archie Bedford second and Ken Stimpson third.
Alan Picton, making a reappearance, won the 220 yds. with Cornish second and Bob Wolton third. In the 440 yds. we saw Dicky Bartlett beat Bob Taylor, with Jim Heathfield in third place.
